title: Archer on Phantom Steed
description: A warrior archer in ornate armor stands dynamically on a rocky outcrop, drawing a bow while two ethereal white horses with flowing manes charge around him. The scene is framed by large white magnolia flowers, twisting dark branches, and swirling mist against a dark background with a luminous full moon.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy warrior in detailed golden and dark armor stands on a rocky ledge drawing a longbow, surrounded by two translucent white ghostly horses with flowing manes galloping through the air, large white magnolia blossoms and dark twisting branches frame the composition, dramatic moonlight glows through swirling mist and clouds, high contrast, elegant linework with painterly shading, dark fantasy aesthetic
